position_overview:
Join Our Team!

We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Graphic Artist to support the development of engaging visual assets across digital and print platforms.

This role is responsible for creating and updating marketing materials, social media graphics, email assets, catalogs, product sell sheets, and other branded content. The ideal candidate has a strong eye for design, proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

What Is Your Mission?

You will provide exceptional service to our partner brands by:
- Creating visual assets for email marketing, social media, print materials, catalogs, and product sell sheets
- Developing creative concepts and design solutions for marketing and advertising initiatives
- Collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand project

- Editing, updating, and refining existing creative assets
- Assisting in the development and maintenance of brand guidelines
- Ensuring brand consistency across all marketing channels and materials
- Supporting the marketing team with creative projects and campaigns
- Staying up to date with design trends, tools, and best practices

Who Are We Looking For?Non-Negotiable

- Minimum of 1-2 years of graphic design experience
- Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including:
- Photoshop
- Illustrator
- InDesign
- Premiere Pro
- Adobe InDesign (Low-Mid Level): Ability to open files, update layouts, and export assets
- Adobe Photoshop (Low-Mid Level): Ability to resize, crop, optimize, and export images
- Basic design skills with the ability to adapt print layouts into user-friendly web content
- Basic knowledge of CSS
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and meet deadlines

Flexible

- Experience working with email marketing assets
- Experience designing social media content
- Experience creating print collateral and catalogs
- Knowledge of web design principles
- Experience working with marketing teams

Skills & Competencies
- Creative thinking and problem-solving skills
- Strong attention to detail
- Good visual design and layout skills
- Ability to receive and apply feedback effectively
- Strong organizational and time-management skills
- Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- Team-player mindset with a positive attitude

- Free upskilling academy to improveyourperformance and skillset.
- State-of-the-art facilities from toilets toyourworkstation.
- Amenities such as sleeping quarters, game area, chat room, shower room.
